title: Speed fly jump and more
features: Speed fly jump hack and more
script:
local success, Rayfield = pcall(function()
    return loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()
end)

if not success then return end

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
   Name = "Bütün Hileler(Geliştiriliyor)",
   LoadingTitle = "Sistemler Hazırlanıyor...",
   LoadingSubtitle = "Delta Mobil - Stabil Sürüm",
   ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = false },
   KeySystem = false
})

-- --- DEĞİŞKENLER --- --
local hedefHiz = 16
local hedefZip = 50
local seciliOyuncu = ""
local BoxAktif, NameAktif, TracersAktif = false, false, false
local BoxColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 165, 0)
local NameColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
local TracerColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)

-- --- IŞINLANMA PANELİ FONKSİYONU --- --
local function CreateTeleportGUI()
    if game:GetService("CoreGui"):FindFirstChild("TeleportGui") then return end
    local TeleportGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", game:GetService("CoreGui"))
    local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame", TeleportGui)
    MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
    MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 2
    MainFrame.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 165, 0)
    MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -100, 0.4, -150)
    MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 300)
    MainFrame.Active = true; MainFrame.Draggable = true

    local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel", MainFrame)
    Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30); Title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 165, 0)
    Title.Text = "Işınlanma"; Title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0); Title.TextSize = 18

    local CloseBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", MainFrame)
    CloseBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30); CloseBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 0)
    CloseBtn.Text = "X"; CloseBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1; CloseBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
    CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() TeleportGui:Destroy() end)

    local PlayerScroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame", MainFrame)
    PlayerScroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 35); PlayerScroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 220)
    PlayerScroll.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 40)
    PlayerScroll.ScrollBarThickness = 5
    
    local UIListLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout", PlayerScroll)
    UIListLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 2)
    UIListLayout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
        PlayerScroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, UIListLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y)
    end)

    for _, p in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= game.Players.LocalPlayer then
            local PBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", PlayerScroll)
            PBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 30) 
            PBtn.Text = p.Name; PBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50); PBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
            PBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                seciliOyuncu = p.Name
                for _, b in pairs(PlayerScroll:GetChildren()) do if b:IsA("TextButton") then b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 50, 50) end end
                PBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 165, 0)
            end)
        end
    end

    local TeleportBtn = Instance.new("TextButton", MainFrame)
    TeleportBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 1, -40); TeleportBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 35)
    TeleportBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 165, 0); TeleportBtn.Text = "Işınlan"
    TeleportBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local target = game.Players:FindFirstChild(seciliOyuncu)
        if target and target.Character then game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:MoveTo(target.Character.PrimaryPart.Position) end
    end)
end

-- --- GENEL SEKİMESİ --- --
local Tab = Window:CreateTab("Genel", 4483362458)

Tab:CreateInput({
   Name = "Yurume Hizi",
   PlaceholderText = "Sayı...",
   Callback = function(Text)
      local n = tonumber(Text)
      if n then hedefHiz = n end
   end,
})

Tab:CreateInput({
   Name = "Ziplama Gucu",
   PlaceholderText = "Sayı...",
   Callback = function(Text)
      local n = tonumber(Text)
      if n then hedefZip = n end
   end,
})

Tab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Fly",
   Callback = function()
      loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://rawscripts.net/raw/Universal-Script-Fly-V3-X-132770"))()
   end,
})

Tab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Işınlanma Paneli",
   Callback = function() CreateTeleportGUI() end,
})

local ESPSectionGenel = Tab:CreateSection("ESP AYARLARI")
Tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Box ESP", CurrentValue = false, Callback = function(v) BoxAktif = v end})
Tab:CreateColorPicker({Name = "Box Rengi", Color = BoxColor, Callback = function(v) BoxColor = v end})
Tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Name ESP", CurrentValue = false, Callback = function(v) NameAktif = v end})
Tab:CreateColorPicker({Name = "İsim Rengi", Color = NameColor, Callback = function(v) NameColor = v end})
Tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Çizgili ESP", CurrentValue = false, Callback = function(v) TracersAktif = v end})
Tab:CreateColorPicker({Name = "Çizgi Rengi", Color = TracerColor, Callback = function(v) TracerColor = v end})

-- --- MM2 SEKİMESİ --- --
local MM2Tab = Window:CreateTab("MM2", 4483362458)

MM2Tab:CreateSection("ÖZEL")

MM2Tab:CreateButton({
   Name = "Işınlanma Paneli",
   Callback = function() CreateTeleportGUI() end,
})

local ESPSectionMM2 = MM2Tab:CreateSection("ESP")
MM2Tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Box ESP", CurrentValue = false, Callback = function(v) BoxAktif = v end})
MM2Tab:CreateColorPicker({Name = "Box Rengi", Color = BoxColor, Callback = function(v) BoxColor = v end})
MM2Tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Name ESP", CurrentValue = false, Callback = function(v) NameAktif = v end})
MM2Tab:CreateColorPicker({Name = "İsim Rengi", Color = NameColor, Callback = function(v) NameColor = v end})
MM2Tab:CreateToggle({Name = "Çizgili ESP", CurrentValue = false, Callback = function(v) TracersAktif = v end})
MM2Tab:CreateColorPicker({Name = "Çizgi Rengi", Color = TracerColor, Callback = function(v) TracerColor = v end})

-- --- ARKA PLAN ÇALIŞTIRICILARI --- --
task.spawn(function()
    local function CreateESP(plr)
        local Box = Drawing.new("Square"); Box.Thickness = 2; Box.Filled = false
        local Name = Drawing.new("Text"); Name.Center = true; Name.Outline = true; Name.Size = 14
        local Tracer = Drawing.new("Line")

        game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                local hrp = plr.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                local screenPos, onScreen = game.Workspace.CurrentCamera:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)
                if onScreen then
                    local sizeX = 2000 / screenPos.Z
                    local sizeY = 3000 / screenPos.Z
                    Box.Visible = BoxAktif; Box.Color = BoxColor; Box.Size = Vector2.new(sizeX, sizeY); Box.Position = Vector2.new(screenPos.X - sizeX / 2, screenPos.Y - sizeY / 2)
                    Name.Visible = NameAktif; Name.Color = NameColor; Name.Text = plr.Name; Name.Position = Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y - (sizeY / 2) - 15)
                    Tracer.Visible = TracersAktif; Tracer.Color = TracerColor; Tracer.From = Vector2.new(game.Workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.X / 2, game.Workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.Y / 2); Tracer.To = Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)
                else
                    Box.Visible = false; Name.Visible = false; Tracer.Visible = false
                end
            else
                Box.Visible = false; Name.Visible = false; Tracer.Visible = false
            end
        end)
    end
    for _, v in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do if v ~= game.Players.LocalPlayer then CreateESP(v) end end
    game.Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(v) CreateESP(v) end)
end)

game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    pcall(function()
        local hum = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = hedefHiz; hum.JumpPower = hedefZip end
    end)
end)
